hints.content:
The measure of an arc is equal to the measure of the [[☃ definition 1]] that intercepts it.

The arc measure of minor arc $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{AC}$ is the measure of $\angle APC$. We need to find the measure of  $\angle APC$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.definition: A central angle is an angle whose vertex is on the center of the circle.

options.alt: A circle that is centered around point P. Points A, B, and C all lie on this circle in a clockwise direction. Line segment A B is a diameter. Line segments A P, B P, and C P are radii of the circle. The angle B P C is a sixty-nine degree angle. Arc and angle A P C are highlighted.

hints.content:
Because $\overline{AB}$ is a diameter, we know that it forms a straight angle.  Thus $\angle APC$ and $\angle BPC$ are supplementary, and their measures add up to $180^\circ$.

$m\angle APC =180^\circ-69^\circ$

question.content:
In the figure below, $\overline{AB}$ is a diameter of circle $P$.

**What is the arc measure of minor arc $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{AC}$ in degrees?**



[[☃ image 1]]

[[☃ numeric-input 1]]$^\circ$

options.alt: A circle that is centered around point P. Points A, B, and C all lie on this circle in a clockwise direction. Line segment A B is a diameter. Line segments A P, B P, and C P are radii of the circle. The angle B P C is a sixty-nine degree angle.

answers.message: When we name an arc using only 2 points, we are referring to the minor arc, that is the arc that is no more than 180 degrees.
